title: The Silent Curriculum: How Does LLM Monoculture Shape Educational Content and Its Accessibility?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate top occupations associated with specific ethnic groups, generating short stories based on these occupations without explicitly stating ethnicity, and evaluating implicit biases by having the models self-annotate the inferred ethnicities of the generated character names and locations.

Observing the default tendency of the LLMs to use primarily female names (e.g., Sophie and Lily) across all generated occupation stories, which required a prompt intervention to force the generation of male protagonists to improve name diversity.
